cards.title: Fly to the 2 NM initial, RWY {to.runway}
instructions: Intercept the extended centerline 2 NM out at no more than a 45° angle
cards.source: Binder, pp. 40–41; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 38–43.

exchange.speaker: Approach
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Approach, no observed traffic between you and the Rockport Airport, change to advisory frequency is approved.

radio.script: “Aransas County Traffic, <callsign>, <direction and distance from airfield> at <altitude>, inbound for a left overhead RWY {to.runway}, Aransas County Traffic.”

cards.title: Check in on KRKP Common
cards.detail: Report the 2 NM initial on CTAF: "2 mile initial RWY {to.runway} for a left overhead, Aransas County Traffic."
cards.source: Binder, pp. 40–42; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 37.
